title: Recovering Towed-In Vehicles Before Disassembly: Repair Estimates & Appointments Safety Note
content:
**Note.** Recovering a vehicle that came in on a network-arranged tow for a Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown, a tow-in charge having been posted on the booking, adds a recovery add-on to the teardown charge:

- such a vehicle with a deployed airbag recorded on the booking, whose restraint system must be disarmed before disassembly, adds **95.00 USD**;
- such a vehicle with no deployed airbag adds **45.00 USD**;
- any other vehicle adds none.

| Tow-in charge posted on the booking | Deployed airbag recorded on the booking | Recovery add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 95.00 USD |
| Yes | No | 45.00 USD |
| No | Yes | none |
| No | No | none |

Hypothetical cases: a vehicle driven in with a deployed airbag has no tow-in charge on its booking and adds nothing; a towed-in vehicle whose airbags did not deploy adds 45.00 USD; a towed-in vehicle with a deployed airbag adds 95.00 USD.
